title: SPERANZA SECURITY RECRUITMENT
body:
# SPERANZA SECURITY RECRUITMENT

# **Speranza needs YOU!**

ARC activity is on the rise, and Raiders are moving deeper into the new Northern Frontiers, leaving Speranza Security stretched to its limits. Tube Operators are already clocking extra hours, which is why Shani is bringing on new recruits to help bring Raiders home safely from Pendola Pass.

This is your moment, Raider. Join the Speranza Security team and lend your voice to the new Gondola extract!

Send in a recording of your voice lines for the chance to become a new Gondola operator, the one guiding cold, weary Raiders back to safety. The strongest submissions will be added directly into ARC Raiders, putting your voice into the Rust Belt, and you'll earn Raider Tokens as a reward for taking part.

You can submit a line under either of these two categories:

# **Category A - Scripted**

Record one of the following Gondola operator lines:

* "Let's see, I have... Yes, on its way. Looks like it's going to go... Northeast. Yes, start heading northeast."

* "Sending a Gondola, Raider. Looks like it's heading... East of you. Yes, it's going east."

* "Let me see what I can do... All right, coming your way. Start heading southeast."

* "Ballistic gondola, on the way. Let's see where it's... All right, should be landing south of you."

* "Got your signal. Gondola is taking off, and... Let's ... Heading to your southwest. Repeat: to your southwest."

* "It's coming your way, Raider. Flight path's looking good. Should be landing west of you."

* "Let's get you home, Raider. There's a Gondola headed your way. Should be there soon - head northwest if you want to catch it."

* "Call received. Ballistic Gondola on the way to... To the north of you, looks like. Yes, start going north."

# **Category B - Original**

Write and record your own original extraction operator line, following the guidance below. The Category A lines can serve as inspiration.

What your character knows:

* A Raider has called in a Ballistic Gondola from a specific, known transceiver somewhere around Pendola Pass.

* You can give a rough estimate of where the Gondola will land relative to that transceiver's position, but this is far from precise.

* You must tell the Raider one of eight compass directions for the landing spot: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, or northwest.

* You have no idea which Raider placed the call. In general, you don't know most Raiders on a personal level.

* Raiders cannot talk back to you, and you have no visual access to the surface.

* Ballistic Gondolas are new, experimental technology, so every operator is still learning how to run them.

Examples of character choices you can make:

* What kind of shift has it been so far? Are you stressed, excited, overwhelmed, or determined?

* How long have you been doing this job? Is this your normal post, or are you covering for someone else?

* How do you feel about Raiders? Do you see them as arrogant and difficult, or do they inspire you?

Guidelines on phrasing and tonality:

* Remember that ARC Raiders takes place in the future, so operators should not use contemporary slang.

* Don't mention the weather, since the line could play in many different weather conditions.

* Don't reference specific ARC machines, since their presence can vary between rounds.

* Operators never give their name when introducing themselves.

* Operators are civilians, not Raiders. They never go Topside themselves, and most of what they know comes second-hand.

* Because operators exist within our game world, out-of-game references are strictly forbidden.

# **Submission guidelines**

Your submitted audio clip must be no longer than 10 seconds.

Submissions will be filtered out if they contain any of the following:

* Hateful and/or political dog whistles, including obscure or local ones.

* Any religious phrases or references.

* Any contemporary slang, including 'clankers'.

* Any out-of-fiction references, including:

* streamers' inside jokes or catchphrases

* references to other games

* references to pop culture

* memes and trending audio

* Any lines referencing present-day AI developments or culture.

# **Submit your audio**

Upload your audio clip submission, 10 seconds maximum, in WAV format, through the submission form.

For the best chance of being selected, check the guide covering how to record audio at home.

Read the full terms and conditions. Our Privacy Policy applies.
